aliases: Free the Money, Free the World
entity.summary: Centralized cryptocurrency exchange identity created by the 2021-09-29 rebrand of Bitcoin.com Exchange. Current first-party FMFW.io surfaces continue to present live spot, margin, futures, account, and exchange services.
entity.notes: FMFW.io is modeled as the successor identity to Bitcoin.com Exchange rather than as an unrelated exchange. First-party rebranding material documents continuity of customer credentials, 2FA, wallet addresses, open orders, and custody across the 2021-09-29 transition. Current FMFW.io exchange, About, and user-agreement surfaces remain available in 2026. HEI uses Global rather than inferring a jurisdiction from changing operator/footer language without a reviewed durable operating-jurisdiction artifact.

events.title: FMFW.io identity launched through Bitcoin.com Exchange rebrand
events.description: Bitcoin.com Exchange adopted the FMFW.io identity and domain on 2021-09-29 while preserving customer account and trading continuity.
events.notes: HEI uses the exact public rebrand date as the launch marker for the FMFW.io successor identity; it does not imply that the underlying trading service or customer accounts began from zero on that date.

evidence.title: Rebranding FAQ
evidence.notes: First-party FAQ establishes the FMFW.io transition date and continuity of existing Bitcoin.com Exchange accounts, credentials, wallet addresses, open orders, and API behavior apart from the root domain change.

evidence.title: Bitcoin.com Exchange is becoming FMFW.io
evidence.notes: Successor-operated announcement describes the September 29 rebrand from Bitcoin.com Exchange to FMFW.io and continued user access through the same credentials.

evidence.title: FMFW.io About us
evidence.notes: Current first-party About page identifies FMFW.io as a cryptocurrency exchange and describes its matching engine, market-maker connectivity, API, and exchange features.

evidence.title: FMFW.io User Agreement
evidence.notes: Current first-party user agreement describes the FMFW.io Exchange as providing account-based purchase and sale of virtual currencies and documents continuing exchange-service availability subject to jurisdictional restrictions.
